description: The mechanical aspects of hydration in FLAC3D are handled by a modified Drucker-Prager constitutive model where elastic and strength properties depend on the hydration grade, \(\alpha\) (Hinze 1987). [ * ] Due to a dormant phase, the evolution of strength and stiffness starts with some delay. This is taken into account by the minimum degree of hydration, \(\alpha_0\) . This value marks the transition between the suspension and solid-state behavior. Beyond \(\alpha_0\) , strength and stiffness do not always depend linearly on hydration grade.
